annotations.exact_quote: Such process of recovering label distributions from logical labels is defined as label enhancement (LE)
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确将从逻辑标签恢复标签分布的过程定义为标签增强，并以此提出GLLE，属于核心研究任务。

annotations.exact_quote: The learning process on the instances labeled by label distributions is called label distribution learning (LDL).
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要定义LDL为对以标签分布标注实例的学习，标题也表明论文面向标签分布学习。
提出的算法名为Graph Laplacian Label Enhancement，且摘要称利用特征空间拓扑信息，符合图拉普拉斯/邻域结构正则化。

annotations.exact_quote: leveraging the topological information of the feature space and the correlation among the labels
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要说明恢复标签分布时利用标签间相关性，显式建模标签相关结构。

annotations.exact_quote: many training sets only contain simple logical labels rather than label distributions due to the difficulty of obtaining the label distributions directly
annotations.reason_zh: 逻辑标签相对标签分布是粗粒度/不完整监督，论文以从逻辑标签恢复标签分布为实质问题，符合弱监督设定。
